ayahs.textArabic: حٰمۤ  ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥā mīm.
ayahs.textEnglish: Ha. Mim.

ayahs.textArabic: تَنْزِيْلٌ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Tanzīlum minar-raḥmānir-raḥīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: THE BESTOWAL from on high [of this revelation] issues from the Most Gracious, the Dis­penser of Grace:

ayahs.textArabic: كِتٰبٌ فُصِّلَتْ اٰيٰتُهٗ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Kitābun fuṣṣilat āyātuhū qur'ānan ‘arabiyyal liqaumiy ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: a divine writ, the messages whereof have been clearly spelled out as a discourse in the Arabic tongue for people of [innate] knowl­edge,

ayahs.textArabic: بَشِيْرًا وَّنَذِيْرًاۚ فَاَعْرَضَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Basyīraw wa nażīrā(n), fa'a‘raḍa akṡaruhum fahum lā yasma‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: to be a herald of glad tidings as well as a warning. And yet, [whenever this divine writ is offered to men,] most of them turn away, so that they cannot hear [its message];

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا قُلُوْبُنَا فِيْٓ اَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُوْنَآ اِلَيْهِ وَفِيْٓ اٰذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَّمِنْۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعْمَلْ اِنَّنَا عٰمِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū qulūbunā fī akinnatim mimmā tad‘ūnā ilaihi wa fī āżāninā waqruw wa mim baininā wa bainika ḥijābun fa‘mal  innanā ‘āmilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and so they say, [as it were:] “Our hearts are veiled from whatever thou callest us to, [O Muhammad,] and in our ears is deafness, and between us and thee is a barrier. Do, then, [whatever thou wilt, whereas,] behold, we shall do [as we have always done]!”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۟ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوْحٰىٓ اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَآ اِلٰهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيْمُوْٓا اِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوْهُ ۗوَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul innamā ana basyarum miṡlukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhuw wāḥidun fastaqīmū ilaihi wastagfirūh(u), wa wailul lil-musyrikīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say thou, [O Prophet:] “I am but a mortal like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God: go, then, straight towards Him and seek His forgiveness!” And woe unto those who ascribe divinity to aught beside Him,

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْتُوْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna lā yu'tūnaz-zakāta wa hum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] those who do not spend in charity: for it is they, they who [thus] deny the truth of the life to come!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُوْنٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun gairu mamnūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But,] verily, they who have attained to faith and do good works shall have a reward unending!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قُلْ اَىِٕنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُوْنَ بِالَّذِيْ خَلَقَ الْاَرْضَ فِيْ يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُوْنَ لَهٗٓ اَنْدَادًا ۗذٰلِكَ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul a'innakum latakfurūna bil-lażī khalaqal-arḍa fī yaumaini wa taj‘alūna lahū andādā(n), żālika rabbul-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY: “Would you indeed deny Him who has created the earth in two aeons? And do you claim that there is any power that could rival Him, the Sustainer of all the worlds?”

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلَ فِيْهَا رَوَاسِيَ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا وَبٰرَكَ فِيْهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيْهَآ اَقْوَاتَهَا فِيْٓ اَرْبَعَةِ اَيَّامٍۗ سَوَاۤءً لِّلسَّاۤىِٕلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘ala fīhā rawāsiya min fauqihā wa bāraka fīhā wa qaddara fīhā aqwātahā fī arba‘ati ayyām(in), sawā'al lis-sā'ilīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For He [it is who, after creating the earth,] placed firm mountains on it, [towering] above its surface, and bestowed [so many] blessings on it, and equitably apportioned its means of subsistence to all who would seek it: [and all this He created] in four aeons.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰىٓ اِلَى السَّمَاۤءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْاَرْضِ ائْتِيَا طَوْعًا اَوْ كَرْهًاۗ قَالَتَآ اَتَيْنَا طَاۤىِٕعِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡummastawā ilas-samā'i wa hiya dukhānun faqāla lahā wa lil-arḍi'tiyā ṭau‘an au karhā(n), qālatā atainā ṭā'i‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He [it is who] applied His design to the skies, which were [yet but] smoke; and He [it is who] said to them and to the earth, “Come [into being], both of you, willingly or unwillingly!” - to which both responded, “We do come in obedience.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَضٰىهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمٰوَاتٍ فِيْ يَوْمَيْنِ وَاَوْحٰى فِيْ كُلِّ سَمَاۤءٍ اَمْرَهَا ۗوَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَاۤءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيْحَۖ وَحِفْظًا ۗذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيْرُ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa qaḍāhunna sab‘a samāwātin fī yaumaini wa auḥā fī kulli samā'in amrahā, wa zayyannas-samā'ad-dun-yā bimaṣābīḥa wa ḥifẓā(n), żālika taqdīrul-‘azīzil-‘alīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He [it is who] decreed that they become seven heavens in two aeons, and imparted unto each heaven its function. And We adorned the skies nearest to the earth with lights, and made them secure: such is the ordaining of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُوْا فَقُلْ اَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa in a‘raḍū faqul anżartukum ṣā‘iqatam miṡla ṣā‘iqati ‘ādiw wa ṡamūd(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: BUT IF they turn away, say: “I warn you of [the coming of] a thunderbolt of punishment like the thunderbolt [that fell upon the tribes] of Ad and Thamud!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ جَاۤءَتْهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْٓا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ ۗقَالُوْا لَوْ شَاۤءَ رَبُّنَا لَاَنْزَلَ مَلٰۤىِٕكَةً فَاِنَّا بِمَآ اُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż jā'athumur-rusulu mim baini aidīhim wa min khalfihim allā ta‘budū illallāh(a), qālū lau syā'a rabbunā la'anzala malā'ikatan fa'innā bimā ursiltum bihī kāfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Lo! There came unto them [God’s] apostles, speaking of what lay open before them and what was [still] beyond their ken, [and calling unto them,] “Worship none but God!” They answered: “If our Sustainer had willed [us to believe in what you say], He would have sent down angels [as His message-bearers]. As it is, behold, we deny that there is any truth in what you [claim to] have been sent with!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَقَالُوْا مَنْ اَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۗ اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۗ وَكَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ammā ‘ādun fastakbarū fil-arḍi bigairil-ḥaqqi wa qālū man asyaddu minnā quwwah(tan), awalam yarau annallāhal-lażī khalaqahum huwa asyaddu minhum quwwah(tan), wa kānū bi'āyātinā yajḥadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now as for [the tribe of] Ad, they walked arrogantly on earth, [offending] against all right, and saying, “Who could have a power greater than ours?” Why - were they, then, not aware that God, who created them, had a power greater than theirs? But they went on rejecting Our messages;

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيْحًا صَرْصَرًا فِيْٓ اَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيْقَهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا ۗوَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَخْزٰى وَهُمْ لَا يُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa arsalnā ‘alaihim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī ayyāmin naḥisātil linużīqahum-‘ażābal khizyi fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wa la‘ażābul-ākhirati akhzā wa hum lā yunṣarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and thereupon We let loose upon them a storm wind raging through days of misfortune, so as to give them, in the life of this world, a foretaste of suffering through humiliation: but [their] suffering in the life to come will be far more humiliating, and they will have none to succour them.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمَّا ثَمُوْدُ فَهَدَيْنٰهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمٰى عَلَى الْهُدٰى فَاَخَذَتْهُمْ صٰعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُوْنِ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ammā ṡamūdu fa hadaināhum fastaḥabbul-‘amā ‘alal-hudā fa akhażathum ṣā‘iqatul-‘ażābil-hūni bimā kānū yaksibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And as for [the tribe of] Thamud, We offered them guidance, but they chose blindness in pre­ference to guidance: and so the thunderbolt of shame­ful suffering fell upon them as an outcome of all [the evil] that they had wrought;

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَجَّيْنَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْا يَتَّقُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa najjainal-lażīna āmanū wa kānū yattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and We saved [only] those who had attained to faith and were conscious of Us.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ اَعْدَاۤءُ اللّٰهِ اِلَى النَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوْزَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yauma yuḥsyaru a‘dā'ullāhi ilan-nāri fahum yūza‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, [warn all men of] the Day when the enemies of God shall be gathered together before the fire, and then shall be driven onward,

ayahs.textArabic: حَتّٰىٓ اِذَا مَا جَاۤءُوْهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَاَبْصَارُهُمْ وَجُلُوْدُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥattā iżā mā jā'ūhā syahida ‘alaihim sam‘uhum wa abṣāruhum wa julūduhum bimā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: till, when they come close to it, their hearing and their sight and their [very] skins will bear witness against them, speaking of what they were doing [on earth].

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا لِجُلُوْدِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدْتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا ۗقَالُوْٓا اَنْطَقَنَا اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْطَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَّهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۙ وَّاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū lijulūdihim lima syahittum ‘alainā, qālū anṭaqanallāhul-lażī anṭaqa kulla syai'iw wa huwa khalaqakum awwala marrah(tin), wa ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they will ask their skins, “Why did you bear witness against us?” - [and] these will reply: “God, who gives speech to all things, has given speech to us [as well]: for He [it is who] has created you in the first instance - and unto Him you are [now] brought back.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُوْنَ اَنْ يَّشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ اَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُوْدُكُمْ وَلٰكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيْرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā kuntum tastatirūna ay yasyhada ‘alaikum sam‘ukum wa lā abṣārukum wa lā julūdukum wa lākin ẓanantum  annallāha lā ya‘lamu kaṡīram mimmā ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And you did not try to hide [your sins] lest your hearing or your sight or your skins bear witness against you: nay, but you thought that God did not know much of what you were doing –

ayahs.textArabic: وَذٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِيْ ظَنَنْتُمْ بِرَبِّكُمْ اَرْدٰىكُمْ فَاَصْبَحْتُمْ مِّنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa żālikum ẓannukumul-lażī ẓanantum birabbikum ardākum fa aṣbaḥtum minal-khāsirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and that very thought which you thought about your Sustainer has brought you to perdition, and so now you find yourselves among the lost!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنْ يَّصْبِرُوْا فَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ ۚوَاِنْ يَّسْتَعْتِبُوْا فَمَا هُمْ مِّنَ الْمُعْتَبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa iy yaṣbirū fan-nāru maṡwal lahum, wa iy yasta‘tibū famā hum minal-mu‘tabīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And then, [even] if they endure [their lot] in patience, the fire will still be their abode; and if they pray to be allowed to make amends, they will not be allowed to do so:

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَاۤءَ فَزَيَّنُوْا لَهُمْ مَّا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِيْٓ اُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا خٰسِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qayyaḍnā lahum quranā'a fa zayyanū lahum mā baina aidīhim wa mā khalfahum wa ḥaqqa ‘alaihimul-qaulu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-ins(i), innahum kānū khāsirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for [when they became obli­vious of Us,] We assigned to them [their own evil impulses as their] other selves, and these made appear goodly to them whatever lay open before them and whatever was beyond their ken. And so, the sentence [of doom] will have fallen due upon them together with the [other sinful] com­munities of invisible beings and humans that passed away before their time: verily, they [all] will indeed be lost!

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَا تَسْمَعُوْا لِهٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ وَالْغَوْا فِيْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālal-lażīna kafarū lā tasma‘ū lihāżal-qur'āni walgau fīhi la‘allakum taglibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW THOSE who are bent on denying the truth say [unto one another]: “Do not listen to this Qur’an, but rather talk frivolously about it, so that you might gain the upper hand!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَنُذِيْقَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا عَذَابًا شَدِيْدًاۙ وَّلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ اَسْوَاَ الَّذِيْ كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa lanużīqannal-lażīna kafarū ‘ażāban syadīdā(n), wa lanajziyannahum aswa'al-lażī  kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But We shall most certainly give those who are [thus] bent on denying the truth a taste of suffering severe, and We shall most certainly requite them according to the worst of their deeds!

ayahs.textArabic: ذٰلِكَ جَزَاۤءُ اَعْدَاۤءِ اللّٰهِ النَّارُ لَهُمْ فِيْهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ ۗجَزَاۤءً ۢبِمَا كَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żālika jazā'u a‘dā'illāhin-nāru lahum fīhā dārul-khuld(i), jazā'am bimā kānū bi'āyātinā yajḥadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: That requital of God’s enemies will be the fire [of the hereafter]: in it will they have an abode of immeasurable duration as an outcome of their having knowingly rejected Our messages.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا رَبَّنَآ اَرِنَا الَّذَيْنِ اَضَلّٰنَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ اَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُوْنَا مِنَ الْاَسْفَلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālal-lażīna kafarū rabbanā arinal-lażaini aḍallānā minal-jinni wal-insi naj‘alhumā taḥta aqdāminā liyakūnā minal-asfalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they who [in their life on earth] were bent on denying the truth will [thereupon] exclaim: “O our Sustainer! Show us those of the invisible beings and humans that have led us astray: we shall trample them underfoot, so that they shall be the lowest of all!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللّٰهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوْا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ اَلَّا تَخَافُوْا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوْا وَاَبْشِرُوْا بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِيْ كُنْتُمْ تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna qālū rabbunallāhu ṡummastaqāmū tatanazzalu ‘alaihimul-malā'ikatu allā takhāfū wa lā taḥzanū wa absyirū bil-jannatil-latī kuntum tū‘adūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But,] behold, as for those who say, “Our Sustainer is God,” and then steadfastly pursue the right way - upon them do angels often descend, [say­ing:] “Fear not and grieve not, but receive the glad tiding of that paradise which has been promised to you!

ayahs.textArabic: نَحْنُ اَوْلِيَاۤؤُكُمْ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِى الْاٰخِرَةِ ۚوَلَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيْٓ اَنْفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَا تَدَّعُوْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Naḥnu auliyā'ukum fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā wa fil-ākhirah(ti), wa lakum fīhā mā tasytahī anfusukum wa lakum fīhā mā tadda‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: We are close unto you in the life of this world and [will be so] in the life to come; and in that [life to come] you shall have all that your souls may desire, and in it you shall have all that you ever prayed for,

ayahs.textArabic: نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُوْرٍ رَّحِيْمٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Nuzulam min gafūrir raḥīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: as a ready welcome from Him who is much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنْ اَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّنْ دَعَآ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَّقَالَ اِنَّنِيْ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa man aḥsanu qaulam mimman da‘ā ilallāhi wa ‘amila ṣāliḥaw wa qāla innanī minal-muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And who could be better of speech than he who calls [his fellow-men] unto God, and does what is just and right, and says, “Verily, I am of those who have surrendered themselves to God”?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ ۗاِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِيْ هِيَ اَحْسَنُ فَاِذَا الَّذِيْ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهٗ عَدَاوَةٌ كَاَنَّهٗ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā tastawil-ḥasanatu wa las-sayyi'ah(tu), idfa‘ bil-latī hiya aḥsanu fa'iżal-lażī bainaka wa bainahū ‘adāwatun ka'annahū waliyyun ḥamīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: But [since] good and evil cannot be equal, repel thou [evil] with something that is better and lo! he between whom and thyself was enmity [may then become] as though he had [always] been close [unto thee], a true friend!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يُلَقّٰىهَآ اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ صَبَرُوْاۚ وَمَا يُلَقّٰىهَآ اِلَّا ذُوْ حَظٍّ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā yulaqqāhā illal-lażīna ṣabarū, wa mā yulaqqāhā illā żū ḥaẓẓin ‘aẓīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet [to achieve] this is not given to any but those who are wont to be patient in adversity: it is not given to any but those endowed with the greatest good fortune!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللّٰهِ ۗاِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa immā yanzagannaka minasy-syaiṭāni nazgun fasta‘iż billāh(i), innahū huwas-samī‘ul-‘alīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, if it should happen that a prompting from Satan stirs thee up [to blind anger], seek refuge with God: behold, He alone is all-hearing, all-knowing!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ الَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُۗ  لَا تَسْجُدُوْا لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُوْا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَهُنَّ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ اِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min āyātihil-lailu wan-nahāru wasy-syamsu wal-qamar(u), lā tasjudū lisy-syamsi wa lā lil-qamari wasjudū lillāhil-lażī khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyāhu ta‘budūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now among His signs are the night and the day, as well as the sun and the moon: [hence,] adore not the sun or the moon, but prostrate yourselves in adoration before God, who has created them - if it is Him whom you [really] worship.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا فَالَّذِيْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُوْنَ لَهٗ بِالَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُوْنَ ۩
ayahs.textLatin: Fa inistakbarū fal-lażīna ‘inda rabbika yusabbiḥūna lahū bil-laili wan-nahāri wa hum lā yas'amūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And though some be too proud [to listen to this call], they who [in their hearts] are with thy Sustainer extol His limitless glory by night and by day, and never grow weary [thereof].

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنَّكَ تَرَى الْاَرْضَ خَاشِعَةً فَاِذَآ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاۤءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْۗ اِنَّ الَّذِيْٓ اَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰى ۗاِنَّهٗ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min āyātihī annaka taral-arḍa khāsyi‘atan fa iżā anzalnā ‘alaihal-mā'ahtazzat wa rabat, innal-lażī aḥyāhā lamuḥyil-mautā, innahū ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: For among His signs is this: thou seest the earth lying desolate - and lo! when We send down water upon it, it stirs and swells [with life]! Verily, He who brings it to life can surely give life to the dead [of heart as well]: for, behold, He has the power to will anything.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُلْحِدُوْنَ فِيْٓ اٰيٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَاۗ اَفَمَنْ يُّلْقٰى فِى النَّارِ خَيْرٌ اَمْ مَّنْ يَّأْتِيْٓ اٰمِنًا يَّوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ ۗاِعْمَلُوْا مَا شِئْتُمْ ۙاِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna yulḥidūna fī āyātinā lā yakhfauna ‘alainā, afamay yulqā fin-nāri khairun am may ya'tī āminay yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), i‘malū mā syi'tum, innahū bimā ta‘malūna  baṣīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, they who distort the meaning of Our mes­sages are not hidden from Us: hence, which [of the two] will be in a better state - he that is [destined to be] cast into the fire, or he that shall come secure [before Us] on Resurrection Day? Do what you will: verily, He sees all that you do.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِالذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَاۤءَهُمْ ۗوَاِنَّهٗ لَكِتٰبٌ عَزِيْزٌ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna kafarū biż-żikri lammā jā'ahum, wa innahū lakitābun ‘azīz(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, they who are bent on denying the truth of this reminder as soon as it comes to them - [they are the losers]: for, behold, it is a sublime divine writ:

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يَأْتِيْهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهٖ ۗتَنْزِيْلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيْمٍ حَمِيْدٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā ya'tīhil-bāṭilu mim baini yadaihi wa lā min khalfih(ī), tanzīlum min ḥakīmin ḥamīd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: no falsehood can ever attain to it openly, and neither in a stealthy manner, [since it is] bestowed from on high by One who is truly wise, ever to be praised.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ اِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيْلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ ۗاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوْ مَغْفِرَةٍ وَّذُوْ عِقَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā yuqālu laka illā mā qad qīla lir-rusuli min qablik(a), inna rabbaka lażū magfiratiw wa żū ‘iqābin alīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And as for thee, O Prophet,] nothing is being said to thee but what was said to all [of God’s] apostles before thy time. Behold, thy Sustainer is indeed full of forgiveness - but He has also the power to requite most grie­vously!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنٰهُ قُرْاٰنًا اَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوْا لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ اٰيٰتُهٗ ۗ ءَاَ۬عْجَمِيٌّ وَّعَرَبِيٌّ ۗ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا هُدًى وَّشِفَاۤءٌ ۗوَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ فِيْٓ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَّهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًىۗ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِنْ مَّكَانٍۢ بَعِيْدٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau ja‘alnāhu qur'ānan a‘jamiyyal laqālū lau lā fuṣṣilat āyātuh(ū), a'a‘jamiyyuw wa ‘arabiyy(un), qul huwa lil-lażīna āmanū hudaw wa syifā'(un), wal-lażīna lā yu'minūna fī āżānihim waqruw wa huwa ‘alaihim ‘amā(n), ulā'ika yunādauna mim makānim ba‘īd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now if We had willed this [divine writ] to be a discourse in a non-Arabic tongue, they [who now reject it] would surely have said, “Why is it that its messages have not been spelled out clearly? Why - [a message in] a non-Arabic tongue, and [its bearer] an Arab?” Say: “Unto all who have attained to faith, this [divine writ] is a guidance and a source of health; but as for those who will not believe - in their ears is deafness, and so it remains obscure to them: they are [like people who are] being called from too far away.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيْهِ ۗوَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗوَاِنَّهُمْ لَفِيْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيْبٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ātainā mūsal-kitāba fakhtulifa fīh(i), wa lau lā kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laquḍiya bainahum, wa innahum lafī syakkim minhu murīb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus, too, have We vouchsafed revelation unto Moses aforetime, and thereupon disputes arose about it. And [then, as now,] had it not been for a decree that had already gone forth from thy Sustainer, all would indeed have been decided between them [from the outset]. As it is, behold, they [who will not believe in this divine writ] are in grave doubt, amounting to suspicion, about what it portends.

ayahs.textArabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهٖ ۙوَمَنْ اَسَاۤءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۗوَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيْدِ  ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Man ‘amila ṣāliḥan fa linafsih(ī), wa man asā'a fa ‘alaihā, wa mā rabbuka biẓallāmil lil-‘abīd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: WHOEVER does what is just and right, does so for his own good; and whoever does evil, does so to his own hurt: and never does God do the least wrong to His creatures.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ اِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ ۗوَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرٰتٍ مِّنْ اَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ اُنْثٰى وَلَا تَضَعُ اِلَّا بِعِلْمِهٖ ۗوَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيْهِمْ اَيْنَ شُرَكَاۤءِيْۙ قَالُوْٓا اٰذَنّٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِنْ شَهِيْدٍ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ilaihi yuraddu ‘ilmus-sā‘ah(ti), wa mā takhruju min ṡamarātim min akmāmihā wa mā taḥmilu min unṡā wa lā taḍa‘u illā bi‘ilmih(ī), wa yauma yunādīhim aina syurakā'ī, qālū āżannāka mā minnā min syahīd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: In Him alone is vested the knowledge of when the Last Hour will come. And no fruit bursts forth from its calyx, and no female ever conceives, nor ever gives birth, save with His knowledge. And so, on the Day when He shall call out to them, “Where, now, are those [alleged] partners of Mine?” - they will [surely] answer, “We confess unto Thee that none of us can bear witness [to anyone’s having a share in Thy divinity]!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَظَنُّوْا مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّحِيْصٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ḍalla ‘anhum mā kānū yad‘ūna min qablu wa ẓannū mā lahum mim maḥīṣ(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, all that they were wont to invoke aforetime will have forsaken them; and they shall know for certain that there is no escape for them.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَسْـَٔمُ الْاِنْسَانُ مِنْ دُعَاۤءِ الْخَيْرِۖ وَاِنْ مَّسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوْسٌ قَنُوْطٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yas'amul-insānu min du‘ā'il-khair(i), wa im massahusy-syarru fa ya'ūsun qanūṭ(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: MAN NEVER TIRES of asking for the good [things of life]; and if evil fortune touches him, he abandons all hope, giving himself up to despair.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَىِٕنْ اَذَقْنٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّاۤءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُوْلَنَّ هٰذَا لِيْۙ وَمَآ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَاۤىِٕمَةًۙ وَّلَىِٕنْ رُّجِعْتُ اِلٰى رَبِّيْٓ اِنَّ لِيْ عِنْدَهٗ لَلْحُسْنٰىۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِمَا عَمِلُوْاۖ وَلَنُذِيْقَنَّهُمْ مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيْظٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa la'in ażaqnāhu raḥmatam minnā mim ba‘di ḍarrā'a massathu layaqūlunna hāżā lī, wa mā aẓunnus-sā‘ata qā'imah(tan), wa la'ir ruji‘tu ilā rabbī inna lī ‘indahū lal-ḥusnā, fa lanunabbi'annal-lażīna kafarū bimā ‘amilū, wa lanużīqannahum min ‘ażābin galīẓ(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet whenever We let him taste some of Our grace after hardship has visited him, he is sure to say, “This is but my due!” - and, “I do not think that the Last Hour will ever come: but if [it should come, and] I should indeed be brought back unto my Sus­tainer, then, behold, the ultimate good awaits me with Him! But [on the Day of Judgment] We shall most cer­tainly give those who were bent on denying the truth full understanding of all that they ever did, and shall most certainly give them [thereby] a taste of suffering severe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَآ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْاِنْسَانِ اَعْرَضَ وَنَاٰ بِجَانِبِهٖۚ وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُوْ دُعَاۤءٍ عَرِيْضٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā an‘amnā ‘alal-insāni a‘raḍa wa na'ā bijānibih(ī), wa iżā massahusy-syarru fażū du‘ā'in ‘arīḍ(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, too, when We bestow Our blessings upon man, he tends to turn aside and keep aloof [from remembering Us]; but as soon as evil fortune touches him, he is full of wordy prayers!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُمْ بِهٖ مَنْ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِيْ شِقَاقٍۢ بَعِيْدٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul ara'aitum in kāna min ‘indillāhi ṡumma kafartum bihī man aḍallu mimman huwa fī syiqāqim ba‘īd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: HAVE YOU given thought [to how you will fare] if this be truly [a revelation] from God, the while you deny its truth? Who could be more astray than one who places himself [so] deeply in the wrong?

ayahs.textArabic: سَنُرِيْهِمْ اٰيٰتِنَا فِى الْاٰفَاقِ وَفِيْٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ حَتّٰى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ اَنَّهُ الْحَقُّۗ اَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ اَنَّهٗ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Sanurīhim āyātinā fil-āfāqi wa fī anfusihim ḥattā yatabayyana lahum annahul-ḥaqq(u), awalam yakfi birabbika  annahū ‘alā kulli syai'in syahīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: In time We shall make them fully understand Our messages [through what they perceive] in the utmost horizons [of the universe] and within them­selves, so that it will become clear unto them that this [revelation] is indeed the truth. [Still,] is it not enough [for them to know] that thy Sustainer is witness unto everything?

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَآ اِنَّهُمْ  فِيْ مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْ لِّقَاۤءِ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ اَلَآ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُّحِيْطٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Alā innahum fī miryatim mil liqā'i rabbihim, alā innahū bikulli syai'im muḥīṭ(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Oh, verily, they are in doubt as to whether they will meet their Sustainer [on Judgment Day]! Oh, verily, He encompasses everything!
